_comment: CHURN CARD — BASELINE ARM (3 h, 63 sta, DOY-129, cold).  Derived from
_ft63_24h_conv.json, the config the 2026-08-02 churn decomposition was measured on,
with THREE deltas and no others: 3 h instead of 24 h, its own snapshot path (so no arm
can warm-resume off another's state and read as a clean cold start), and its own output
paths.  D5 v2 exactly as it ran there — innov_gate + calibrate, corroborate OFF,
WHAT IT IS FOR.  The reference the v3 and v4 arms are read against.  The measured
pathology on the 24 h leg: 525 009 slip refloats of which 513 482 (97.8 %) are the D5
gate's own flag -> re-tap -> funnel limit cycle, mean chord lifetime 4.3 epochs,
dd_sigma_cyc pinned ~3.9 cyc and med|frac_cyc| uniform at every baseline.
1. n_chord_births / n_slip_refloats per epoch (network_epoch_status.csv) — the churn;
2. dd_sigma_cyc: does it leave the ~3.9 cyc pin (scripts/grade_ddfrac_perhour.py);
3. med|frac_cyc|: does it leave 0.25 (uniform = zero integer information);
4. total_IF spread / worst_med — the NO-HARM check.  A churn win that moves this is
Read epoch-status columns BY NAME: the indices around n_arc_refloat(17) / n_d5_flags(18)
/ n_d5_retaps(19) / n_chord_births(20) / n_slip_refloats(21) are off by one.
